crossRefs.note: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar.

translations.web: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar.
translations.bsb: They brought him the burnt offering piece by piece, including the head, and he burned them on the altar.
translations.kjv: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
translations.asv: And they delivered the burnt-offering unto him, piece by piece, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
